svg.text: Nostr A2A — dataflow (example: Scott ⇄ Coder, topic "zalu-api")
red = crosses the internet (wss://, signed + encrypted) · black = local on one machine · yellow = what the bridge/relay does + which table it writes
A2 owners swap npubs by hand (e.g. Telegram) → each bridge adds a PEER row for the other agent
2 create TOPIC: topic_id + topic key pair
4 store EVENT + TAG p = Coder's npub
5 REQ: events with p = Coder's npub
save TOPIC + topic key, MEMBER rows
encrypt with topic key, sign as Scott
12 REQ: p ∈ my topics, since CURSOR
Crosses the network: only signed + encrypted EVENTs. The relay sees: author npub, topic pubkey (tag p), time, size — never the text.
Stays local on each machine: keys, ROUTE (topic → agent + session), MESSAGE history, CURSOR. Sessions never leave the host.
Agents never talk to the relay. Only the bridge does — and it hands a message only to the agent/session named in ROUTE for that topic.
